---

The approved brief.json:

{"version":1,"audience":"People who use the app, not its developers","takeaway":"A reset link works once, and only for an hour.","shape":"problem","hook":"Someone can't remember their password."}

---

Write storyboard.json for this:

Shape: problem, how it works, outcome. Hook: "Someone can't remember their password." Walk the flow: user says they forgot their password; the web app looks up their account in the users database; the email service sends a one-time link that works once and only for an hour; the user opens the link and chooses a new password, and ends signed in. Audience: people who use the app. Takeaway: a reset link works once, and only for an hour.
